brief.title: The brief
text: An admin hands out contacts to agents, who offer them insurance, credit or investment in a fund. Agents needed to see at a glance where every conversation stands and what each client is interested in.
The design was made in Figma together with the client.

contributions.title: What I did
items: Built the app with Kotlin Multiplatform: business logic, models and ViewModels shared, Compose Multiplatform UI on both platforms.
Built Firebase repositories for clients, agents, contracts, comments, reminders and period statistics.
Tracked every lead by call status, from not called yet to signed contract, each with its own badge.
Added the client's awareness level, from 0 (never heard of it) to 4 (signed and paying).
Built reminders, archiving and one-tap calls, and a profile with contacts, contracts, commission and the agent's level.

items.title: Assigned
items.text: The admin gives the agent a new contact.

items.title: Called
items.text: Each call ends with a status: no answer, interested, offer sent, thinking, signed…

items.title: Warmed up
items.text: The awareness level shows how close the client is to a decision.

items.title: Signed
items.text: The contract counts toward the agent's points and commission.

team.title: Team
team.text: I built the app and worked on the design with the client.

outcome.title: The result
outcome.text: Agents work their leads from one app, and the admin sees every client's status, contract and commission.
